title: Coefficients of a function
statement: Let $n$ and $\ell$ be natural numbers and let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2$. Associate to each subset $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ of size at most $\ell$ the coefficient of the monomial indexed by $S$ in the algebraic normal form of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the $n$-dimensional binary cube to $\mathbb F_2$
the coefficient is assigned for each subset of size at most $\ell$
